summary.name: Anthora
summary.one_liner: Anthora is a free Mac app for browsing, searching, and cleaning up photos and videos stored in folders, and for turning albums into printable photo books and PDFs.
keywords: find duplicate photos without moving files
use_cases: Browse and search a large photo collection across folders and drives
Find exact and resized duplicate photos and videos
Clean up screenshots and low-quality captures
Turn a wedding or trip album into a photo book
Export a photo book as a print-ready PDF at 150 or 300 dpi
Organize photos on an external drive or network share without moving originals
summary.what_it_does: Anthora lets you choose ordinary folders on a Mac, external drive, or mounted network share and indexes them into a searchable workspace without moving the source files. It supports searching the local index with included on-device analysis. Its cleanup tools review exact copies, resized images, and videos with sampled shared footage, plus queues for screenshots, low-quality captures, and accidental videos. Removed items stay recoverable in Anthora for 30 days. The Books feature builds photo books from an album, search, or selection, with six sizes, fourteen layouts, and PDF export.
notable: Works from ordinary folders and does not read the Photos.app library directly
Books support up to 200 pages with auto-fill for up to 200 photos
Matches and quality signals are suggestions; the user decides what is deleted
caveats: Requires an Apple silicon Mac (M1 or newer) running macOS 14 or later
Direct download is not notarized by Apple, so a one-time macOS Open confirmation is needed
Semantic language search, best-shot grouping, and crop-aware matching are not included in this release
Printing is purchased separately and printer-specific covers and physical proofing are not included
